public_source: CyberDefenders.org — Case 166, SpottedInTheWild. Evidence and walkthrough publicly available at cyberdefenders.org.
notes: Single-machine case: Windows endpoint DESKTOP-2R3AR22 (hostname), evidence via KAPE collection c125_Kape/ and VHD c125-SpottedInTheWild.vhd.
Phase 16 (CVE Attribution) requires Claude invocation via run_cve_attribution.sh after investigation_report.md is produced.
The scheduled task 'whoisthebaba' was deleted before collection — it is recoverable from MFT ($I30 + USN Journal) but not present in Tasks CSVs.
Massive timestomping (9,049 uSecZero entries) is a post-exploitation framework indicator consistent with Metasploit or Cobalt Strike.
